title: Same-condition coverage batch: five other settled-fact categories (v2 template)
purpose: If b01-template-v2 produces >=2 fact-qualified, non-homogeneous candidates, test whether the same fixed writing instruction generalizes to the five coverage categories. Do not run before that gate.

model.why: Same loaded instance as b01 when 10 can batch them; no new model.

template.system: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
template.instruction: 请把下面的已结算状态写成一段中文小说正文，180 到 260 字。必须写出【本回合变化】里的移动、时间推进、物品变化和人物变化；可以写细微动作、对白和视角人物的感受，但不得新增人物、物品、地点、事件、往事或承诺；不要逐条复述状态，不要写标题或列表。
template.whyThisInstruction: same instruction frozen in preregistration.v2; no case-specific wording

gate: Do not submit before b01 raw outputs are analyzed and the preregistered diversity/zero-qualified conditions are checked. A zero-qualified or >80% repetition b01 triggers cause analysis first, not automatic expansion.

resource.device: one HPC GPU, same node class as b01 if possible

onlyChangeVsB02: the same fixed writing instruction as b01-template-v2; case set, seeds, model, sampling, cap and rubric unchanged
